people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

translations.web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
translations.bsb: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
translations.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
translations.asv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
